findings.summary: Check 09's only PASS route is state HTTP GET /v1/takeover; when the state_takeover MCP tool exists it is detected but never called, so an MCP-only takeover face (spec: 'R5 后为 state_takeover') can never turn 09 green — permanent false red, though never a false PASS

Check 17 omits the first half of the criterion ('名册线 MCP 工具集无 dd-mcp 入口'); only rounds.jsonl evidence (dd.dispatch.v1/dd.gate_release.v1 present, no dd-mcp call records) is probed, so PASS is reachable while a dd-mcp entry could still exist in roster line toolsets
Check 06 executor direction verifies rejection of the synthetic acceptance mutation but not the required rejection 留痕 (only the supervisor-direction contract_changed traces are searched)

Check 18's same-line grep (file-name hit and read pattern on one line) can miss two-line read-of-terminal.json/.scheduler patterns (Path(...) then .read_text() on the next line) — a false-green blind spot inherent to the grep-based method the spec prescribes
Check 02 counts the substring 'coord.' anywhere in the /v1/protocols body instead of only within kind fields — conservative direction (can only over-report FAIL, never PASS)
